d:
Looking for a gentle, effective way to stretch—without getting down on the floor? This 20-minute standing stretch routine combines dynamic and static stretches to help you warm up your body, improve flexibility, and relax tight muscles.
You’ll move through a full-body sequence to:
Improve flexibility and mobility
Reduce stiffness and tension
Support balance and posture
Boost circulation and energy
No equipment needed—just press play and move at your own pace.
